description: This file defines the RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse class, which encapsulates the response data for a retrieve connection status command in a connectivity management module. It includes fields for connection ID, status, timestamps, and resource statuses, along with methods for creating instances from JSON, building response objects, and accessing response data.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse
classes.description: Defines the response structure for retrieving the status of a connection, including status fields, timestamps, and resource statuses, with JSON serialization/deserialization support.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions specific to RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse, such as connection status, live status, timestamps, and resource status lists.

classes.name: RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse.Builder
classes.description: Provides a builder pattern to construct instances of RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse with customizable status, timestamps, and resource status lists.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new response instance with specified connection ID, JSON object, and headers.

methods.name: closedResponse
methods.description: Generates a response indicating a closed connection, with relevant status and timestamp details.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a JSON string or object into a RetrieveConnectionStatusResponse instance.

methods.name: getLiveStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current live connection status.

methods.name: getConnectedSince
methods.description: Gets the timestamp since when the connection was established.

methods.name: getClientStatus
methods.description: Gets the statuses of clients associated with the connection.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Replaces the response's JSON entity with a new one and returns a new response instance.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Returns the JSON representation of the response payload.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets new headers for the response, returning a new instance.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer to the resource represented by this response.
